redRegressions.before: Clones omitted source author/version/hash; draft/publication reads accepted wrong filenames; mismatched review author was accepted; null review caused NullPointerException.
redRegressions.after: New clone provenance pins the exact source; reads check paths and document identity; review author/ID/version/hash must match; null review fails with IOException.

redRegressions.before: A different author could submit a higher version under an existing publication ID or the bundled starter ID; saveDraft could create a 65th author directory beyond the scan budget.
redRegressions.after: Submitted/published IDs bind the original author, the bundled starter ID is reserved, and all author-creation paths check the 64-directory limit before creating.

legacyFixtures.origin: Exported from the verified 7021845 shaded JAR before P7 changes.
legacyFixtures.outcome: Approved schema-v1 publication with the old short clone source remains playable. Repeated approval preserves both publication and review bytes; new copies pin its exact original hash.

failureMatrix: Failed submission creates no review or publication; retry succeeds.
Failed approval-record write preserves pending bytes and keeps the version private.
Failed publication write preserves the committed APPROVED decision; only its reviewer can retry publication after restart.
Failed rejection preserves pending bytes; successful retry persists rejection and hides the version.
Reviewed identity remains bound to its author before approval and after rejection/restart.
Legacy publication and review keep their original schema, source and hash.

dependencyValidation.sharedGraph: 16 layers of two shared nodes each plus a root: 32 dependency pins resolved exactly once each.
checks: Longest path remains bounded when a cached node is reached more deeply.
Full transitive dependencies include non-Arena design types.
Missing or mismatched pins and missing publicRead/allowClone are rejected.
Cyclic resolver data rejects without unbounded recursion.
Validation caches are scoped to one call and do not retain stale permissions.
dependencyValidation.scope: Deterministic unit-level resolver-call evidence, not a server throughput benchmark.

limitations: No new Paper/Folia client or human UGC governance/anti-cheat acceptance run.
Review approval and publication remain separate atomic files; a durable APPROVED decision can precede a failed publication and requires original-reviewer retry.
A submitted draft changed by its author cannot publish under the prior content hash; new content requires a higher-version submission.
Existing legitimate pre-review publications remain readable. No historical sources or author ownership are automatically rewritten.
New submissions reserve their public ID for the author, including rejected submissions; reassignment and moderation policy remain operational work.
Memory-constrained non-forked tests and ephemeral signer keys do not establish production performance or official signing.
The P0-P11 objective remains active and phase gates retain their documented incomplete status.
